baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ادعوا الذين زعمتم, لا يملكون مثقال ذرة, no شرك, and no ظهير.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative turns an assertion into an executable summons. The claimants must exhibit direct disposition, a jointly held stake, or derivative backing; the atom-weight threshold and the paired heavens and earth reduce every route to zero.

activation_trace.role: Calling draws an addressee by speech and supplies the operational summons.
Uncertain assertion supplies the unverified status that the summons tests.
Ownership with power of disposition supplies the first and strongest agency route.
Measured weight supplies the audit threshold rather than an unmeasured metaphor.
Minute dispersed particles drive the threshold toward the smallest distributed unit.
Participation in a jointly held thing supplies the second agency route.
Strength gained from a backer or helper supplies the final derivative route.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply says that other gods possess nothing.
changed_reading.after: Every asserted intermediary undergoes a zero-threshold agency audit: no direct control, no joint stake, and no supporting role anywhere.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لا يملكون مثقال ذرة and the terminal denial of a ظهير.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch inventory lets ملك denote cohesion as well as title, while ذرة supplies scattered granularity and ظهير supplies load-bearing equipment. The denial can therefore test whether a claimant can hold together, organize, or carry even the slightest material unit.

activation_trace.role: Strength and cohesion recast possession as the grip by which a system holds.
A calibrated weight makes that grip test materially exact.
Scattering grain or powder supplies matter that must be gathered or governed despite dispersion.
A carried load and its equipment supply the image of external load-bearing capacity.

changed_reading.before: ملك is only legal ownership and ظهير is only a personal ally.
changed_reading.after: The denied power also looks like an absence of material grip: the claimants cannot cohere, organize, or bear the least dispersed unit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ادعوا الذين زعمتم من دون الله followed by the denials of شرك and ظهير.
baseline_models.mechanism: دعوى can carry an asserted right or affiliation, while زعم can carry guarantee and chieftainship. The called figures can thus be alleged patrons who are summoned to underwrite a relationship, only to be shown without stake or backing capacity.

activation_trace.role: An asserted right or affiliation supplies the relational claim behind the call.
Guarantee and surety cast the claimed figures as supposed underwriters.
A chief who stands for a group supplies the patron or representative role.
A jointly held stake is the standing an underwriter would need.
Backed assistance is the patronage function explicitly removed at the end.

changed_reading.before: The objects of devotion are merely named and rejected.
changed_reading.after: Alleged guarantors, chiefs, and patrons are summoned to underwrite the relation claimed for them, but possess neither standing nor backing power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired realms become a system of ingress, emergence, descent, and ascent, while the repeated atom-weight formula is placed inside a no-escape record. Dominion is therefore not static title alone but exhaustive command and accounting over every crossing and scale.

activation_trace.role: Disposition supplies the focus claim whose operational content is expanded by context.
Entry into an interior makes the earth a permeable boundary rather than a static parcel.
Passage outward completes the earth-side flow pair.
Descent and arrival supply downward transit through the heavenly domain.
Ascent supplies the reciprocal upward transit.
Distance, absence, and escape are explicitly denied at the repeated particle scale.
An inscription that fixes an obligation or decree turns total awareness into accountable registration.

structural_cues: 34:2 pairs entry with exit and descent with ascent across the same earth-heaven frame used by the focus.
34:3 repeats مثقال ذرة في السماوات ولا في الأرض, extends the scale to smaller and larger, and places all of it in a clear record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal flows and a particle from which nothing is absent in the record. I infer that operative dominion includes governing and accounting for flows, not title alone. A live alternative is that 34:2-3 contrasts divine knowledge with creaturely possession without equating the two.

changed_reading.before: The claimants lack static property in two vast territories.
changed_reading.after: They lack control over every boundary crossing and lack the exhaustive particle-level accounting that operative dominion requires.

context_deltas.mechanism: David and Solomon's exceptional capacities arrive as gifts, measured craft, assigned work, and permission. The focus denial therefore distinguishes autonomous title and co-rule from real but delegated creaturely action.

activation_trace.role: Independent disposition is the focus category that delegated capacities do not become.
Giving supplies an upstream grant rather than self-originating power.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit constrains the craft.
Pierced links bound into sequence supply technically effective but composed agency.
Purposeful work confirms that creatures can genuinely act.
License to act supplies the governing gate on that work.

structural_cues: 34:10-12 repeatedly place extraordinary material and labor capacities downstream of giving, command, measurement, and the Lord's permission.
These capacities are narrated before the focus's absolute denials of ملك, شرك, and ظهير.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effective craft and labor together with grant and permission. I infer that the focus negates autonomous sovereignty, not every secondary cause. A live alternative is that the narratives merely display favors to prophets without defining the semantic scope of ملك in 34:22.

changed_reading.before: No non-divine being has any effective agency.
changed_reading.after: Non-divine agents may work with striking efficacy, but gift, measure, command, and permission prevent that efficacy from becoming ownership or partnership.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hidden, creeping consumer eats the staff on which Solomon's body appears supported; the fall reveals that the working jinn did not know the hidden state. The focus's denied ظهير acquires a load-bearing and epistemic mechanism: apparent command can persist while its prop is concealed, then vanish when the prop fails.

activation_trace.role: A backer from whom strength is taken supplies the focus endpoint.
Creeping on the earth supplies the minute agent that reaches the hidden prop.
Consumption as corrosion or decay supplies the mechanism of support failure.
The staff used to drive or push supplies the physical prop being consumed.
A sounding, disordered fall makes the loss of support observable.
Emergence into clarity turns collapse into disclosure.
Concealment from sight supplies the epistemic condition that lets apparent command continue.

structural_cues: 34:14 sequences unnoticed consumption, the fall, and only then the jinn's realization.
The episode follows the granted labor system of 34:12-13 and precedes the focus's denial of any ظهير.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an eaten staff, collapse, and delayed disclosure of ignorance. I infer that the staff functions as a material analogue for a ظهير and that concealed dependency explains apparent autonomy. A live alternative is that ظهير in the focus remains exclusively a personal helper and the staff analogy is only structural.

changed_reading.before: A ظهير is simply an ally absent from the rival gods' side.
changed_reading.after: The verse also denies any hidden prop capable of sustaining their apparent agency; support itself is contingent, consumable, and revelatory when it fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: Iblis's conjecture appears confirmed because people follow it, yet the next ayah denies him coercive authority. Immediately afterward, the focus tells those same people to call what they claimed. Rival power is thus exposed as socially realized uptake without intrinsic sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: An assertion lacking certainty anchors the focus to the preceding conjecture.
Conjecture and uncertainty supply the projected expectation that later appears confirmed.
Following behind supplies the human uptake that makes the conjecture socially effective.
Power and jurisdiction name precisely what the successful follower relation does not confer.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty supply the state exposed by the test.
Comprehensive guarding assigns actual oversight elsewhere.

structural_cues: 34:20 says the conjecture was confirmed through following; 34:21 immediately denies سلط and names the differentiation of belief from doubt.
34:22 then addresses the claim-makers directly with the call-and-demonstrate challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, followership, and an explicit denial of authority. I infer that uptake causes the appearance of power while not creating sovereignty. A live alternative is that followership is only evidence used in a test, not the causal medium of Iblis's influence.

changed_reading.before: The claimants are powerless objects external to their worshipers.
changed_reading.after: Their apparent power can be generated by a feedback loop of conjecture and followership, but collective uptake still yields no سلط, ملك, or شرك.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ayah immediately after the focus allows beneficial intercession only through permission. Pairing or joining another party can occur, but it is an authorized attachment rather than autonomous partnership or self-owned backing.

activation_trace.role: An independently shared stake supplies the relation that is denied.
Self-standing assistance supplies the denied mediation model.
Benefit states the outcome that mediation cannot produce on its own.
A mediator joining another party supplies a dependent relational link.
Permission supplies the gate that makes the joined relation operative.
Removal of fright supplies a state change that still occurs downstream of the permission gate.

structural_cues: 34:23 begins with another absolute negation and then an explicit exception keyed to permission.
It follows the focus without an intervening ayah, directly calibrating the denial of supporting agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonbenefiting intercession, an exception, and permission. I infer that permission is the causal gate separating mediation from partnership. A live alternative is that the exception identifies only eligible recipients and does not describe the mediator's causal status.

changed_reading.before: No mediation or assistance can exist at all.
changed_reading.after: Autonomous mediation is impossible, while permission-gated joining can convey benefit without becoming ownership, partnership, or independent backing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated commands move from calling the claimants, to identifying the provider, to gathering the parties for judgment, and finally to producing the alleged partners for inspection. The focus is one stage in a burden-of-proof procedure.

activation_trace.role: The focus summons the alleged party into the test.
An unverified allegation supplies the claim whose burden is being tested.
Allocated provision supplies a concrete function for which a responsible source must be named.
Gathering the separated parties supplies the hearing's assembly.
Opening a closure by judgment supplies adjudication of the competing claims.
Causing something to be seen turns assertion into a demand for an exhibit.
Attaching an affiliate to another supplies the alleged partner relation under examination.

structural_cues: 34:22, 34:24, 34:25, 34:26, and 34:27 form an uninterrupted sequence of قل-led challenges.
The sequence moves from auditory invocation to functional attribution, adjudication, and visual production of the attached partners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a summons, a provider question, gathering, judgment, and a command to show the attached partners. I infer a staged evidentiary hearing. A live alternative is that the repeated commands are pedagogical rhetoric without a procedural sequence.

changed_reading.before: Call them is a taunt whose failure is assumed.
changed_reading.after: Call them initiates a formal burden-of-proof sequence in which alleged function, legal standing, and visible identity are successively demanded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Followers and elites return accusations to one another: the weak attribute their stance to the great, the great deny having blocked them, and the weak identify continuous commands to install rivals. The focus's claimed guarantors and backers become a social hierarchy whose members cannot underwrite one another's choice or liability.

activation_trace.role: Surety supplies the underwriting function that the blame exchange fails to sustain.
Leadership standing for a group supplies the patron role assigned to the elites.
Returning speech supplies reciprocal blame rather than accepted responsibility.
Lack of strength identifies the dependent social position.
Rank and leadership identify the supposed backers at the top of the hierarchy.
Command and obligation supply the directional pressure alleged by the followers.
A counterpart set against another supplies the rivals the hierarchy told them to install.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stages alternating speech by the weak and the great, with each side relocating causal responsibility.
The weak move from a general counterfactual accusation to the specific mechanism of repeated command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hierarchy, commands, and reciprocal blame. I infer that patronage promised social backing but cannot transfer moral agency or liability. A live alternative is that the focus's الذين refers only to worshiped beings, while the later human hierarchy is analogous rather than referential.

changed_reading.before: The unsupported claim concerns only remote divine substitutes.
changed_reading.after: The same no-backer logic exposes human patronage systems: leaders can solicit allegiance and followers can lend force, but neither side can guarantee or carry the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accumulated wealth and children are claimed as protection, but provision is expanded and narrowed from elsewhere, does not purchase proximity, and what is spent can be replaced. Apparent holdings are a variable allocation, not the autonomous ملك denied in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Ownership with disposition supplies the stronger category against which holdings are tested.
Rivalry through superior number supplies the boast's metric of security.
Acquiring and multiplying assets supplies the apparent possession.
Expansion and increase make provision a variable upstream allocation.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the reversible opposite of expansion.
Favored nearness at a ruler's side supplies the status wealth fails to secure.
A successor that comes after and replaces what left makes holdings replenishable rather than self-grounding.

structural_cues: 34:35 explicitly joins greater assets and offspring to a claim of immunity.
34:36-39 answer with expansion, constriction, failed proximity, expenditure, and replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a security boast and a variable provision cycle. I infer that contingent holding must be distinguished from sovereign disposition. A live alternative is that ملك in 34:22 is exclusively cosmic rule, so ordinary wealth is only a moral comparison.

changed_reading.before: The rivals own literally nothing, a statement that sits awkwardly beside ordinary creaturely property.
changed_reading.after: Creatures may hold a changing portfolio, but abundance, proximity, and replacement reveal that holding as allocated dependence rather than autonomous sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the alleged objects of worship are questioned, they disown the worshipers and declare God their own wali apart from them. The claimed support relation reverses upstream; the next ayah denies every person's power to own benefit or harm for another.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the true patronage relation claimed by the speakers.
Otherness reverses the focus construction: God, not the worshipers, is the speakers' patron.
Disposition is repeated in a person-to-person frame and denied.
Benefit names the positive outcome no person can transfer by ownership.
Harm names the reciprocal negative outcome outside that ownership.

structural_cues: 34:40-41 stage a direct question to the alleged worshiped addressees and record their disavowal.
The phrase أنت ولينا من دونهم reverses the directional relation in من دون الله at 34:22.
34:42 repeats لا يملك and converts cosmic scale into the inability of one party to control another's outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disavowal, an explicitly reversed wali relation, and denied transfer of benefit and harm. I infer that patronage necessarily points upstream to God and cannot run laterally from the claimed figures to their claimants. A live alternative is that the speakers in 34:41 are a narrower class than every figure challenged in 34:22.

changed_reading.before: The claimants chose patrons who simply turn out to be resource-poor.
changed_reading.after: The alleged patrons are themselves dependent clients whose true patronage points to God; they cannot own or transfer either side of another's outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus removes rival agency across spatial domains; 34:49 removes it across temporal phases. Falsehood cannot open a process or bring it back, so the absence of ملك and ظهير includes lack of generative and restorative capacity.

activation_trace.role: Cohesive capacity supplies the focus's operative agency dimension.
Opening and initiating a thing supply the first temporal test.
Inactivity without useful work supplies the subject's incapacity.
Return after departure and repetition after beginning supply the second temporal test.

structural_cues: 34:49 coordinates لا يبدئ and لا يعيد around الباطل.
This late temporal pair complements the focus's exhaustive spatial pair of heavens and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed initiation and failed return by falsehood. I infer that the focus's agency audit extends from spatial jurisdiction to temporal production. A live alternative is that 34:49 concerns truth's arrival as discourse and should not be generalized to the focus claimants.

changed_reading.before: The claimants lack a place or share in the present cosmos.
changed_reading.after: They also lack process power: they cannot originate an effective order or restore one after loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence turns distance into failed causal reach: there is no escape, belief cannot be reached from far away, speech is cast toward the unseen from a remote position, and a barrier finally separates people from desire. The focus call can be uttered, but no ownership, shared stake, or backer creates a channel by which it arrives or returns effective aid.

activation_trace.role: Calling attempts to draw a remote addressee through speech.
Nearness that remains below the goal supplies an intermediary layer without arrival.
Failure of apprehension or arrival supplies the first explicit reach condition.
Taking something by extending toward it supplies the reach that distance defeats.
Throwing over distance supplies projection without secured contact.
What is screened from sight supplies the inaccessible target of projection.
Distance from nearness supplies the separation across which the projection fails.
A barrier separating two things supplies the final closure of the channel.

structural_cues: 34:51-54 repeat near, far, place, reaching, throwing, and separation in a closing spatial sequence.
The sequence moves from failed escape, to belated attempted reach, to remote projection, and finally to an imposed barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a call in the focus and a closing chain of failed reach and separation. I infer that ملك, شرك, and ظهير are alternative causal channels whose absence makes the invocation non-delivering. A live alternative is that the closing distance concerns only belated belief and need not describe invocation.

changed_reading.before: The call fails because the invoked figures are powerless.
changed_reading.after: The call fails as a reachability operation: speech can be launched, but there is no owned domain, shared channel, or supporting relay through which aid can be contacted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant armor image within زعم and reads the David sequence materially; it remains packet-anchored through that supplied branch, the focus's ظهير, and the immediately preceding softened-iron and measured-link narrative. Downstream prose should present it as a protective-system analogy, not as the lexical translation of زعمتم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: زعمتم and the denial of any ظهير.

activation_trace.role: Armor named زعامة supplies an unexpected image for the protection attributed to the claimants.
Load-bearing equipment supplies the external protective backing that the focus removes.
Softness against roughness supplies workable iron rather than self-existing armor.
Iron's resistant hardness supplies the protective material.
Exact measure supplies controlled fabrication.
Perforated links bound together supply protection through a composed network.

changed_reading.before: The claimed figures are imagined only as personal patrons.
changed_reading.after: They may also be imagined as protective armor or a backing network, while the surah's functioning armor is itself granted, softened, measured, and assembled rather than autonomous.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the plural claim in 34:22 as socially maintained and uses the later pair-and-single reflection exercise as an audit protocol. It remains anchored in زعمتم, its leadership branch, and the explicit two-by-two, solitary, then reflective sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social-cognitive reading, not assert that plurality alone proves group pressure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural زعمتم and the public imperative ادعوا.

activation_trace.role: Leadership that speaks for a group supplies the possibility of collectively maintained assertion.
Joining one to one supplies a minimal interpersonal test unit.
The isolated individual removes the larger group's backing.
The heart's repeated examination supplies the cognitive operation after social decompression.

changed_reading.before: زعمتم records a set of individual false beliefs.
changed_reading.after: The claim may be socially stabilized; separating claimants into pairs and individuals tests whether it survives without collective patronage and repetition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant س م م mapping supplied for the focus root س م و and turns its narrow opening into a channel image. It remains anchored in في السماوات, the context's entry-exit motions, and the explicit permission gate on mediation. Downstream prose should call it a topology suggested by a split-root branch, never a lexical claim that السماوات means an aperture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: في السماوات and وما لهم فيهما من شرك.

activation_trace.role: A narrow hole through which something enters supplies the image of a privileged celestial channel.
Entry into an interior supplies motion through a boundary.
Emergence to the outside supplies the reciprocal boundary crossing.
Permission supplies control of any operative mediation channel.

changed_reading.before: No partner owns territory in the heavens.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, no partner possesses even a private aperture or access channel through the heavenly system; operative passage remains permission-controlled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the closing act of casting at the unseen as a model for the focus's unsupported claims and calls. It remains anchored in ادعوا, زعمتم, and the packet's explicit speech-casting, unseen, and distance cluster. Downstream prose should distinguish this epistemic projection model from the stronger general reachability reading and present it as an analogy, not identify every invocation with 34:53.

activation_trace.role: Calling launches speech toward an addressee.
Assertion without certainty supplies the projectile's unsupported content.
Throwing words or accusations supplies the speech-projectile mechanism.
A target screened from sight supplies the unverified destination.
Remote distance supplies the lack of contact between assertion and target.

changed_reading.before: The call fails only because its addressee lacks power.
changed_reading.after: The prior claim itself may be a verbal projectile cast toward an unseen target from too far away to establish evidence, contact, or response.

strongest_changes: The static property denial became an audit of dynamic flows and exhaustive particle-level accounting.
The David-Solomon sequence separated genuine delegated work from autonomous ownership, then made hidden support failure visible through the eaten staff and fall.
The immediate 34:20-23 bracket separated socially effective followership from سلط and recalibrated mediation as permission-gated rather than absolutely absent.
The later disavowal in 34:40-42 reversed the claimed patronage relation and denied person-to-person ownership of benefit or harm.
The closing distance sequence converted invocation into a reachability problem with projection, failed contact, and a final barrier.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence supplied mechanisms rather than loose themes: the exact atom formula became a ledger, extraordinary labor became delegated capacity, a consumed prop embodied ظهير, followed conjecture modeled non-sovereign social power, the next ayah calibrated intercession, and the final spatial cluster exposed the call's missing causal channel.
remaining_uncertainties: The cohesion, load-bearing, armor, and aperture readings are branch-supported material analogies, but their lexical distance keeps them exploratory.
It remains uncertain how much of the guarantor and chieftain resonance of زعم should enter ordinary rendering rather than trace-level commentary.
The repeated formula in 34:3 may contrast divine knowledge with rival possession rather than define possession as accounting.
The closing speech-projectile analogy may diagnose a broader epistemic habit rather than the specific claims challenged in 34:22.
